products.product_title: Serabit El-Khadim Bedouin Camp & 4x4 Desert Safari Adventure
products.short_description: Explore Serabit El-Khadim from Sharm El Sheikh, discover the Temple of Hathor and ancient turquoise mines, then enjoy Bedouin camping and stargazing under the Sinai stars.
products.product_description:
Discover the hidden beauty of Sinai on an unforgettable one-day adventure through the mountains, valleys, and ancient landscapes of Serabit El-Khadim. This experience combines an exciting 4x4 desert safari, ancient Egyptian history, mountain hiking, breathtaking scenery, and authentic Bedouin hospitality, taking you far away from the usual tourist routes.
Your adventure begins at approximately 9:00 AM at Abu Zenima Road, where you will meet your local team and board a 4x4 Jeep specially suited for the desert terrain. Leave the paved roads behind and begin an exciting journey through the rugged mountains, rocks, and valleys of Sinai. Enjoy the changing landscapes as you travel deeper into the desert, with spectacular views and opportunities to stop for photographs along the way.
At around 10:00 AM, arrive at Beit Barakat, a traditional Bedouin house and desert camp surrounded by the mountains of Sinai. Take a break from the journey and enjoy a delicious traditional Bedouin breakfast with freshly prepared Bedouin tea. Relax, meet your local hosts, and experience the peaceful atmosphere and warm hospitality of desert life before beginning the main adventure of the day.
Ancient Temple of Hathor
After breakfast, begin your journey toward the historic Temple of Hathor at Serabit El-Khadim.
The visit includes an approximately 45-minute hike through the mountains. Follow the ancient mountain paths as you climb toward the archaeological site, surrounded by spectacular desert scenery and panoramic views of the surrounding valleys and mountains.
At the summit, discover the ancient Temple of Hathor, one of the most fascinating archaeological sites in Sinai and a place closely associated with the ancient Egyptian turquoise-mining expeditions.
Spend approximately one hour exploring the temple and archaeological area with your guide. Discover the ancient remains, inscriptions, and traces of the activities that once took place in this remote mountain region. Standing among the ruins, surrounded by dramatic mountains and complete silence, offers a unique opportunity to experience ancient Egyptian history in its natural desert setting.
After completing your archaeological tour, begin your descent through the mountains and return to Beit Barakat.
Traditional Bedouin Lunch
After the hike, enjoy a traditional Bedouin lunch at approximately 2:00 PM at Beit Barakat. Relax, enjoy authentic local food, and take in the peaceful mountain surroundings before continuing your desert adventure.
4x4 Safari – Wadi Baba & Serabit El-Khadim
After lunch, get back into your 4x4 Jeep and continue exploring the remote landscapes of Sinai.
Travel through Wadi Baba, a spectacular desert valley surrounded by mountains and dramatic rock formations. Enjoy the scenery, take photographs, and experience the peaceful atmosphere of one of Sinai's remote valleys.

Start your experience with pickup from your hotel or Luxor Airport, then travel in a private air-conditioned vehicle to explore the landmarks you choose. Such as Karnak Temple, the Valley of the Kings, Hatshepsut Temple, or Luxor Temple.

products.product_title: Private Customizable Day Tour to Alexandria from Cairo
products.short_description: Explore Alexandria on a private tour from Cairo with a guide and driver. Visit the Qaitbay Citadel, the Roman amphitheater of Kom El-Deka, and the Catacombs of Kom El Shoqafa.
products.product_description:
Your private guide and driver will pick you up from your hotel in Cairo in the early morning and take you comfortably to Alexandria in a private, air-conditioned vehicle. The journey takes approximately 2.5 to 3 hours, allowing you to enjoy the scenic drive from Cairo to Egypt’s historic Mediterranean coast.

This is a fully private and customizable experience. The sightseeing program is flexible and can be changed according to your interests, preferred pace, and available time. You can follow the suggested itinerary below or choose to visit other attractions in Alexandria based on your preferences.

The suggested sightseeing includes the Qaitbay Citadel, a historic 15th-century fortress built on the site traditionally associated with the ancient Lighthouse of Alexandria. Continue to the Roman Amphitheatre of Kom El-Deka, an important archaeological site, and explore the fascinating Catacombs of Kom El Shoqafa, which combine Egyptian, Greek, and Roman architectural influences.

Lunch Break: Enjoy a delicious lunch at a local restaurant, included in the tour. Bottled water and a soft drink are also provided during the tour.

You may also customize your tour by adding or replacing sightseeing stops, such as Montaza Palace and its gardens, Stanley Bridge, the Bibliotheca Alexandrina, the Alexandria Corniche, or other historical and cultural attractions according to your interests.

Please note that sightseeing visits and entrance tickets are not included in the tour price. The entrance fees depend on the attractions you choose to visit and are paid directly by the customer at each location. The tour price includes private transportation, a professional private guide in the language selected when booking, lunch, bottled water, and a soft drink.

At the end of your customized Alexandria experience, your private driver and guide will accompany you on the journey back to Cairo and drop you off at your hotel.
highlights: Explore Alexandria on a private tour from Cairo with a guide and driver
Visit the Qaitbay Citadel, built on the site of the Lighthouse of Alexandria
Discover the Roman amphitheater of Kom El-Deka & the Catacombs of Kom El Shoqafa
Enjoy a delicious lunch at a local restaurant in Alexandria
Customize your tour with optional stops at Montaza Palace or Stanley Bridge
inclusions: Fully customizable itinerary according to your interests and preferences
exclusions: Additional stops or activities not listed in the main itinerary
